name: Misty Lantern Keep — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Amber timber galleries and open pavilions with upturned teal tiled roofs, stacked on unequal rock piers; arched lower bridge, hanging lantern chains, mist and waterfalls. Detailed study differs from the map's pink-spired shorthand. Hidden layout inference: A lower stone bridge brings visitors under rock arch to a stair landing. A winding ascent alternates open timber balconies, sheltered pavilion stops and narrow planted ledges, with a distinct upper lookout. Keep open views between columns; retain uneven heights rather than a flat slab. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B05-STRUCT-001 — Misty Lantern Keep — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need rock-seat/platform junctions, timber post/rail/bracket modules, stepped gallery landings and roof corner/eave assemblies. Lantern, jade/teal tile and lattice motifs already shown. Ferns/moss/local conifers, quiet moths/owls proposed; water drops use shared family. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
